bug_semantics: The unauthenticated metatags GET endpoint accepts a caller-controlled URL, performs only syntactic URL validation, and makes a server-side fetch to that destination. Because it does not reject loopback, RFC1918, link-local, cloud-metadata, or other internal addresses, an Internet client can use Dub as an SSRF primitive to scan internal services or read sensitive metadata responses.
flaw_origin: Commit abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed created pages/api/edge/metatags.ts as a new consolidated metadata API. Its public GET handler read the url query parameter, checked only that new URL(url) parsed, and passed it to getMetadataFromUrl, which directly executed fetch(url). This new metatags route and its vulnerable handler/fetch chain did not exist in the immediate parent; later parser rewrites and route moves preserved the same trust-boundary error.
ai_marker: absent — git cat-file -p abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed shows author and committer Steven Tey <stevensteel97@gmail.com>; the commit message is only 'Added 3 types of social image previews: Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn' and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, or other AI trailer.
evidence: Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-gvqm-vjxp-3r33 identifies CVE-2026-72552/CWE-918, the unauthenticated metatags edge endpoint, and an affected state as of 2026-07-10; it lists affected and patched versions as Unknown and no package. Origin: `git log -L 7,30:pages/api/edge/metatags.ts abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed` attributes the GET handler, caller URL flow, and opening of direct fetch(url) to abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed; `git log --all --reverse -S'const metatags = await fetch(url' -- ...metatags...` returns that commit first. Parent proof: `git ls-tree -r 317e3978cce47cd36734933529cf609cacac39b8 -- pages/api/edge/metatags.ts` is empty, while the same command at the BIC returns blob b6eb6a2d75a0454b688036e8c7e31783c913e189. The parent has separate title/description endpoints, but not the advisory-specific metatags route or its combined handler/fetch implementation; abe4 is a one-parent feature commit, not a merge/squash or a path-only move. Lifecycle: 06f5c5dd5bac4f10aab3cb754eada7fa361c46aa rewrote parsing but retained fetch(url); 10685f9e04ae69535807e011a136c8c73de9cdaf staged the App Router version; 879261c791966e1b4c2433511e9a5a28bd85e39f activated it and deleted the legacy page; 1ee607a513f80436fddbcfac4d8a40558d3dd034 moved it out of /edge; f42b9a957c0bce980dd243fb54ab31e0c6c0b834 moved it to apps/web/app/api/links/metatags. Boundary: origin/main commit 13f7abc9a6a24c9f83093bf94a48b3bcd8aa02fc on 2026-07-10 contains route.ts calling getMetaTags(url) and utils.ts calling fetchWithTimeout(url); the BIC is its ancestor and the fix is not. The repository has zero tags. Current origin/main 3462d79674bbe3c1161805d956111c2153fb4c6e still calls fetchWithTimeout(url). Fix: https://github.com/dubinc/dub/commit/f6e9c6990013f18abdc873d8ce5d2a049d3de014 on origin/security-ssrf-safe-fetch directly replaces fetchWithTimeout(url) in apps/web/app/api/links/metatags/utils.ts with safeFetch(url), whose new implementation restricts schemes, resolves and rejects private/reserved IPv4/IPv6 destinations, and revalidates redirects; its parent 9fee29dfd48d8d72d55358dcdd33641c77f19e28 still has the unsafe call. `git merge-base --is-ancestor f6e9c6990013f18abdc873d8ce5d2a049d3de014 origin/main` exits 1, proving the fix branch is unmerged. BIC object: https://github.com/dubinc/dub/commit/abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed and raw `git cat-file -p` show the human identity and no AI trailer.
reasoning: The vulnerability is the trust-boundary decision to let an unauthenticated request select the server's outbound destination, not the HTML parsing itself. The smallest advisory-specific origin is abe4c8e15ae21bd1db59f709aac874254536bbed: it newly creates the metatags route, wires a caller query value to the outbound fetch, and provides only parseability validation. The immediate parent lacks that path and combined metatags mechanism. Separate predecessor title/description endpoints explain the product lineage but do not contain this advisory's metatags route; abe4 is not merely a rename, and later parsing changes and route renames are therefore not selected as the BIC. Commit-level boundary checks place the BIC on main before and at the advisory's 2026-07-10 affected snapshot. The direct remediation f6e9c6990013f18abdc873d8ce5d2a049d3de014 replaces the unsafe fetch at the exact sink with destination-aware safeFetch, but it remains only on the security branch; no patched release boundary exists and latest main remains vulnerable. Finally, attribution is limited to the BIC commit object: it has a human author/committer and no AI marker, so the correct causal verdict is NOT_AI regardless of any later work.
remaining_gap: Upstream is still unpatched on its default branch: f6e9c6990013f18abdc873d8ce5d2a049d3de014 exists only on origin/security-ssrf-safe-fetch and is not an ancestor of origin/main. The advisory reports affected/patched versions as Unknown and the repository has no tags, so no patched release/version boundary can be named; latest validated origin/main 3462d79674bbe3c1161805d956111c2153fb4c6e still contains the unsafe fetchWithTimeout(url) call.
